title: Studio Ghibli & Little Prince Family Trip to Paris
summary: A 2-day Paris itinerary for a family with kids aged 6 and 10, blending Studio Ghibli-inspired art, the magic of The Little Prince, and halal-friendly food and prayer stops.
tips: Paris Metro is stroller-friendly; buy a carnet of tickets.
Carry prayer mats or a small bag for mosque prayer stops.
Most museums offer free entry for children under 18.
Riverside cafés near the Seine offer quick halal bites and stroller-accessible seating.
